interface.shortDescription: Design boards, prototypes, images, and video
interface.longDescription: Northlit is an AI design studio. Explore a brief as a board of divergent design direction mocks, build any direction into a working HTML prototype, iterate on it conversationally, generate images and video, and publish to a public URL — all on your own Northlit canvases, on-brand with your Brand DNA. Boards and images render inline; click any card to view it full size.
defaultPrompt: Explore design directions for this brief.
Create a working prototype from this direction.
Generate an image for this concept.
